First, work out where you actually are.

You are here because you want proof.

You are here because you want insight to what is the best move for your current and future project support and digitalization needs.

No pitch on this page. Whatever anyone's trying to sell you, the right next move depends entirely on where your business is on the journey. So start there.

One thing worth knowing before you spend a penny.

Going Digital only earns its place if it moves five things: less cost, less waste, less environmental impact, lower risk, and more profit. Notice that none of them is ‘buy software’.

If a step doesn’t directly contribute to these five goals, it is worth re-evaluating whether it aligns with your strategy before moving forward.

DDC Solutions Helps David Kohn Architects (DKA) Achieve ISO 19650 Compliance and Improve BIM Capabilities

David Kohn Architects (DKA), an esteemed London-based architectural practice renowned for its excellence in arts, education, and residential projects, faced a pivotal moment in 2021. They had secured a significant development project that demanded strict adherence to ISO 19650 standards and processes. While DKA excelled in Computer-Aided Design (CAD), they needed to swiftly adapt to Building Information Modeling (BIM) and Revit to fulfill the project’s requirements. Moreover, DKA had to take on the role of Information Manager for the project.
